measurement_budget.planned_method: Repeat zero and known-offset controls at each pressure; propagate correlated errors and onset-time intervals; no slip claim below combined detection bound.
Calibrate same NiTi lot at matched T/rate/history; use elastic and friction-only controls; classify direct vs indirect support and retain alternative explanations.
Independent geometric reference and sleeve/fixture sham subtraction with covariance.
Measure chamber p only as boundary input; do not estimate local f_n from p alone in S02; pass transmission to S04 calibration.

Matched slow/fast or dwell comparison; propagate temperature uncertainty through independently measured NiTi transformation-stress temperature sensitivity and compare to predeclared future discrimination margin.
Paired controls with identical build except sensor; declare allowed perturbation budget before interpreting mechanism data.

combination_rule: Use a declared uncertainty model with covariance for shared cameras, clocks, temperature and calibration sources; report standard and expanded intervals, not only point estimates. Do not use a universal fixed percentage.
event_rule: Define onset as the first sustained departure beyond predeclared noise/control envelope with persistence chosen before examining the target run. Report interval bounds for slip and transformation onset; coexistence requires interval overlap beyond combined timing ambiguity on the same specimen region and cycle.
resolution_rule: For every required channel, choose sensor resolution and sampling so the predeclared minimum meaningful mechanism change exceeds calibration+noise+drift uncertainty and the fastest expected event is temporally resolved; numeric settings remain human selections after bench characterization.

thermal_decision.ISOTHERMAL_H0b_ALLOWED: Only if measured wire-relevant temperature excursion, rate response and uncertainty imply effects smaller than the predeclared model-discrimination margin across the declared domain, with no systematic rate/history dependence left unexplained.
thermal_decision.THERMOMECHANICAL_H0b_REQUIRED: If thermal/rate shifts may explain the signature or exceed the margin; include heat/latent-heat and measured boundary conditions in H0b before S05 lock.
thermal_decision.INDETERMINATE: If thermal channel does not resolve wire temperature, improve sensing or narrow domain; never default to isothermal.

no_numeric_threshold: No absolute temperature, rate, fatigue, pressure, leak, optical or uncertainty threshold is frozen in this preparation. Human selection must precede energized testing and be traceable to exact hardware/lot calibration and intended discrimination margin.
